title: PostgreSQL: a lost or dropped slot isn't recreated by a full refresh

found.by: expected-entry test round 2026-10-25: PostgreSQL 16.15, DBR 18.3.8 gateway

symptom: After the slot was lost (WAL kept past max_slot_wal_keep_size) or dropped, the next update FAILED with INGESTION_GATEWAY_PG_SLOT_IS_INVALIDATED, or CDC_NOT_ENABLED ("doesn't exist"). A dropped slot is reported as CDC_NOT_ENABLED, not as a deleted-slot class.
cause: The gateway doesn't recreate a slot it was given.
effect: A full refresh of the table completes, and the updates keep failing.
fix: Create the slot by hand, then full refresh the table.
notes: One run: the first update after the loss reported COMPLETED with no error, while the gateway log showed PG_SLOT_IS_INVALIDATED (see snapshot-complete-before-rows).
